title: 12 Best Shenzhen Street Food & Night Markets
description: Explore Shenzhen's vibrant street food scene and bustling night markets. Discover authentic local snacks, regional Chinese delicacies, and unique culinary experiences across the city.

places.name: Dongmen Street Food Market (东门步行街美食街)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Oyster Omelet (Haohao Jian), Spicy Lamb Skewers (Yangrou Chuan'r)

places.name: Huaqiangbei Street Food (华强北美食)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Dan Dan Mian (Spicy Sichuan Noodles), Roujiamo (Chinese 'Burger')

places.name: Yantian Seafood Street (盐田海鲜街)
places.priceRange: ¥80-200+ per person / ~$12-30+ USD (depends on seafood choice)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Steamed Oysters with Garlic & Vermicelli, Spicy Stir-fried Crab, Fried Prawns

places.name: Che Gong Miao Food Street (车公庙美食街)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mala Tang (Spicy Hot Pot Skewers), Grilled Eggplant, Chuan'r (BBQ Skewers)

places.name: Bao'an Food Street / Xixiang (宝安美食街 / 西乡)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Bao'an Stewed Goose, Salt-baked Chicken (Yan Ju Ji), Hakka Tofu

places.name: OCT LOFT Creative Park (华侨城创意文化园)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Artisan Coffee, Gourmet Hot Dogs, Hand-rolled Ice Cream

places.name: Bagua 1st Road Food Street (八卦一路美食街)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Hunan Stir-fries (Xiang Cai), Grilled Fish (Kao Yu), Dim Sum (at specific spots)

places.name: Houhai Coastal City Area (后海海岸城周边小吃)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Hong Kong-style Egg Waffles (Gai Daan Jai), Bubble Tea, Stinky Tofu

places.name: Guanlan Old Street (观澜老街)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Hakka Stuffed Tofu (Niang Doufu), Sweet Potato Porridge, Grass Jelly Dessert

places.name: Window of the World / Happy Valley Surrounding Streets
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Stinky Tofu (Chou Doufu), Tanghulu (Candied Fruit Skewers), Roast Sweet Potatoes

places.name: Gongming Roasted Goose Eateries (光明乳鸽)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Gongming Roasted Goose (served with plum sauce)

places.name: Shazui Road Food Stalls (沙嘴路美食)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order BBQ Skewers (various meats and vegetables), Seafood Congee, Wonton Noodles
